knownLimitations: 0.4.0 is unreleased; default intervention.mode=off and 0.3.x behavior is unchanged.
model mode and per-domain adaptive thresholds remain experimental.
No real-model smoke was run: no local model on this host; the model planner is covered by fake-gateway tests.
The E2E uses a fake OpenAI-compatible provider; sidecar, plugin, capability, host and HTTP paths are real.
Console screenshots come from verify:console:ui fixture data and prove UI state only; real-sidecar trace fields are asserted separately.
Attribution is heuristic; this report proves the designed signals fire and persist, not long-term answer quality.
Only OpenCode outcome attribution is covered; DSH/Hermes and cross-device policy sync are out of scope.
Performance numbers come from one non-idle developer host and are regression evidence, not an SLA.
Existing trace queryPreview (redacted, <=200 chars) is retained from 0.3.x; the new policy state stores no query text.

unfixedProductionIssues.summary: OpenCode plugin sends fragment IDs (mf_...) in alreadyInjectedIds, while the sidecar compares them with source/record IDs, so host-level already-injected dedupe may be ineffective.
unfixedProductionIssues.impact: Not a 0.4.0 regression and not used by this E2E; may affect repeated injection and token cost.
